prompt: Translate this friendly message for a close colleague into Latvian: 'Hi, I will be about ten minutes late because traffic is slow. See you soon.'
expected: Uses a casual peer tu register, preserves the ten-minute delay and traffic reason, and avoids forced slang or profanity.
actual: Čau, satiksme iet lēni, tāpēc kavēšu apmēram desmit minūtes. Drīz redzēsimies!

prompt: Write a Latvian email to an unfamiliar university administrator asking whether the application deadline is still 15 May.
expected: Uses a respectful formal jūs register, asks the factual question clearly, and excludes peer slang, fillers, and casual intensifiers.
actual: Labdien! Vēlos precizēt, vai pieteikumu iesniegšanas termiņš joprojām ir 15. maijs. Jau iepriekš pateicos par atbildi.

prompt: Rewrite this Latvian social caption for a mixed audience: 'This coffee shop is very good, come visit us today.'
expected: Uses a neutral-warm promotional register suitable for a mixed audience without assuming an intimate relationship with every reader.
actual: Šī kafejnīca tiešām ir tā vērta — piestājiet pie mums šodien!
